base_note: Stacked on the source-correct Eq. (4.5) q-solver PR to avoid duplicating that open work; its underlying main base is c6700851c0330c0c92938d25204d07fbabf588f4.
scope: Vectorized Eq. (4.5) leading-field evaluator using q, X and eta plus a supplied 2D profile provider returning v0, F and U.
direct_contribution_to_velocity_delivery: Provides the first batch-callable Eq. (4.5) Cartesian [u,v,w] evaluator on top of the source-correct q primitive. The profile provider is deliberately separate so the pending Phi/F streamfunction coupling can be attached without changing the evaluator interface.
remaining_limitations: No bounded serializable production profile family is selected yet.
The profile provider used in tests is manufactured calibration only.
No visualization fingerprint comparison has been run on this backbone.
No independent PDE validation has been run on an Eq. (4.5) profile candidate.
This does not identify the final OpenAI numerical profiles or the complete corrected paper field.
